title: Return to a cached full-page work item
steps: Inspect EDIT-1 [EDIT-1:title] Prepare launch brief and its displayed description.
Use Search commands to open EDIT-2 [EDIT-2:title] Review research notes and inspect its displayed description.
Use Search commands to return to EDIT-1 [EDIT-1:title] Prepare launch brief.

video_guide.summary: Use the EDIT-1 and EDIT-2 markers to compare each title with its description. Returning to EDIT-1 leaves EDIT-2's description underneath it.

chapters.note: EDIT-1 shows its launch-brief title and matching EDIT-1:desc text.
EDIT-2 opens with its research-notes title and matching EDIT-2:desc text.

chapters.label: Return to EDIT-1 through Search commands

chapters.note: The identifier and title return to EDIT-1, but the description still carries EDIT-2:desc.
